higher_order_evaluator.method: exact <=2 elementary-event contribution plus conditional Monte Carlo of the complete N>=3 independent-Bernoulli tail
higher_order_evaluator.tail_probability: computed from the exact binomial-count convolution for Kp~Binom(Np,p), Kq~Binom(Nq,q), Kl~Binom(Nl,p_loss); no Poisson approximation

tail_sampling.count_sampling: sample total count from exact convolved binomial PMF conditioned on N>=3, then sample (Kp,Kq,Kl) from the exact conditional composition weights
tail_sampling.location_sampling: uniform without replacement within each frozen location type
tail_sampling.conditional_pauli: P2 uniform 1/15; P1 uniform 1/3; Q and loss deterministic
tail_sampling.classification: XOR-combine independently precomputed Clifford fault signatures, then apply the frozen protocol state machine
tail_sampling.per_point_seed: SplitMix64(master_seed xor protocol_id xor (p_index<<8) xor (q_index<<16) xor (loss_index<<24))

uncertainty.type: Hoeffding bound on each conditional-tail Bernoulli metric, propagated by multiplying by exact P(N>=3)
uncertainty.ratio_interval: for epsilon_L_given_A, divide the lower/upper P_L_and_ACCEPT interval by the opposite Y interval endpoints when Y_lower>0

higher_order_evaluator.claim_rule: A protocol ordering is certified on a grid point only when the corresponding all-orders confidence intervals are disjoint in the required direction. Overlap is INCONCLUSIVE, not a tie.

independent_classifier.state_representation: separate Pauli struct with uint16_t x and z fields; no packed x|(z<<n) storage
independent_classifier.fault_application: reconstruct each frozen check circuit and derive event signatures independently; do not read primary raw aggregates or primary event signatures
independent_classifier.pair_enumeration: enumerate all frozen single events and all unordered distinct location pairs with full conditional Pauli realizations for 1+0,2+1,3+1
independent_classifier.comparison_target: raw outcome aggregates and all degree-two polynomial coefficients from the primary classifier
independent_classifier.acceptance: exact equality of every raw aggregate and derived rational coefficient

post_result_new_candidate_rule.allowed_only_after: higher-order grid result and independent classifier result are frozen
post_result_new_candidate_rule.candidate_status: exploratory new version; cannot retroactively alter 1+0,2+1,3+1
post_result_new_candidate_rule.selection_basis: highest-value candidate after observing the frozen full-grid Pareto structure

stop_rules: Do not change grid points, tail shots, seeds, protocol definitions, or fault semantics after numerical exposure.
Do not treat Monte Carlo tail uncertainty as hardware uncertainty.
Do not call same-agent independent classifier an independent review.
Do not promote a post-result round-count candidate as confirmation of the frozen benchmark.
